claims: Monitor vital signs and oxygen saturation closely.
Evaluate the cause of the elevated blood pressure and consider antihypertensive therapy if necessary.
Administer intravenous fluids to address potential volume depletion.
Monitor renal function and consider adjusting medications if necessary.
Monitor coagulation parameters and consider adjusting anticoagulation if needed.
Assess nutritional status and consider enteral or parenteral nutrition support if indicated.
Continue monitoring for signs of infection, given the elevated white blood cell count and neutrophil percentage.
Monitor for potential side effects of medications, especially iron and vitamin supplements.
